title: Inner class suggests itself as child
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-106-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 13.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

For inner classes, the code editor suggests itself as a child (class). This seems wrong and already raises an error when done on the class itself. When done on a class instance, it only errors at runtime.

Edit: See also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/110313 but the `bug` label was removed for some reason.
I'm not sure why parent classes share constants with their child classes but at least the false suggestion(s) should be fixed.

### Steps to reproduce

- create a new empty scene and add a script with the code below, see MRP

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```GDScript
func _ready() -> void:
	# Error: Cannot find member "InnerClass" in base "InnerClass".
	InnerClass.InnerClass

	var inner_class = InnerClass.new()
	# does not raise an error, only at runtime:
	# Invalid access to property or key 'InnerClass' on a base object of type 'RefCounted (InnerClass)'.
	inner_class.InnerClass

class InnerClass:
	pass
```
